The '''Lohopa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Boeus sector/Legends|Boeus sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lohopa II]].
